source.n8n_access: read-only GET /executions only. The one live media turn to date (exec 13584318) is captured separately as exec-13584318.json; this case pins the OTHER 99% of traffic, an ordinary text turn, for which the node must be a no-op.
source.rationale: detect-media sits on EVERY turn, immediately after redis-pop, so the regression that matters most is not the media branch at all: it is that a text turn comes out byte-identical apart from the added `_media`. modality stays null (no attachment -> t and mime are both ''), which sends if-media-in down the FALSE leg straight to tf-message. Two things are deliberately pinned as null here rather than as values: `attachment_type` and `mime_type` collapse '' -> null via `t || null`, and `message_id` is null because THIS synthetic envelope carries no id at all - neither messageId nor channelMessageId is present anywhere under it. That is the only reason it is null: since issue #35 the body reads the id from message.message.message (where a real queue item carries it), not from the A level, so a real text turn now yields a real message_id.
